children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of cash management and Treasury bills on Monday:
BTr awards 52 billion Philippine pesos ($828.22 million), within 52 to 70 billion pesos programme, of which:
BTr fully awards 10 billion pesos worth of 35-day cash management bills at an average rate of 5.124%
Tenders for cash management bills total 12.177 billion pesos
BTR awards 42 billion pesos worth of T-bills, within 42-60 billion pesos programme
BTr awards 20 billion pesos of 91-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.431%
BTr awards 15 billion pesos of 182-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.821%
BTr awards 7 billion pesos of 364-day T-bills at avg rate of 6.043%
Details are on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
